test_name: ICBTH and Bloodymess block Rumble Crackers activation - ac7c8302-21a8-4c59-a096-27cca209e6fa
summary: The ICBTH and Bloody Mess part prefabs, which attach to the arm, each tagged every outgoing hit from that arm with tag value 6. That value used to mean 'BloodyMess', but in 2023 the enum entry was replaced with 'GarageInteraction'. From then on every hit from an arm holding either addon counted as a garage-preview hit, and Rumble Crackers ignores those, so slamming the ground never gave Turbo. The same mistag also silenced other items that skip garage hits (Overdrivers, Turbo Defense System, Hot/Stun/Precision Engineering quirks). I removed the stale tag component from both prefabs. In play mode, a ground hit with Rumble Crackers + Bloody Mess on the left arm and Rumble Crackers + ICBTH on the right arm now puts both arms into Turbo. Putting the old tag back on one arm at runtime brought the bug back on that arm only, which confirms the cause.

verified: Rumble Crackers + Bloody Mess on the left arm: ground hit from code -> arm Turbo, PWR 3 to 4, blue Turbo glow
Rumble Crackers + ICBTH on the right arm: ground hit from code -> arm Turbo, PWR 3 to 4, blue Turbo glow
Cause check: re-adding a GarageInteraction outgoing tag handler on the left arm at runtime -> no Turbo on that arm, right arm still Turbo
Arms keep only their own LeftArm/RightArm tag handlers after the fix
No console errors from the scenario
